title: Novel MRI for an Earlier Diagnosis of Motor Neurone Disease
official: Novel MRI for an Earlier Diagnosis of Motor Neurone Disease
summary: The goal of the study is Can MR Fingerprinting identify quantitative differences in brains of patients with MND and age-matched healthy controls?
criteria:
Inclusion criteria all participants:

* ≥18yrs
* Able and willing to provide consent
* Able to communicate with staff and safely comply with the study procedures

Additional inclusion criteria for MND participants:

* ALS patients with definite or probable motor neuron disease based on the Awaji criteria

Additional inclusion criteria for healthy volunteers:

* Free from chronic or current illness particularly:
* Neurological disorders including migraines
* Psychiatric disorders
* Prior head injury resulting in brain damage
* Prior neurosurgical or neurovascular intervention
* Free from taking medication
* Non-drug and non-alcohol abuse
* Non-smoker

Exclusion criteria all participants:

* Contraindication to MRI, including:

  * non-MRI compatible medical devices and implants
  * in patients with previous penetrating trauma to the eye, or patients at high risk of previous metal foreign body injury to the eye (e.g. welding), skull x-ray will be performed; these patients may be included in the absence of residual metal fragments on x-ray
  * Inability to lie flat in the MRI scanner
  * ALS patients in an advanced disease stage (ALSFRS-R \< 25) with respiratory insufficiency (forced vital capacity (FVC) \< 60%), on non-invasive ventilation or receiving percutaneous gastrostomy feeding.
* Pregnant
sponsor: The Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
